sections.title: You Travel. We Accommodate.
text: Now — smarter, faster and future-ready.

Since 2016, Elyra has been a pioneer in introducing serviced apartments and long-stay accommodation to the Indian corporate market — a bridge between hospitality and business travel. That early move remains a key differentiator and a foundation of our continued success.

Today our capabilities extend well beyond traditional travel services. With Travgenie, our intelligent self-booking platform, we have embraced automation, policy compliance and real-time visibility, while preserving the human expertise our clients trust.
Looking ahead, our focus stays on strengthening digital capabilities, expanding global partnerships and delivering smarter, more connected travel for enterprises.

sections.title: Frequently asked questions
items: What types of ground transport services does Elyra provide?

Airport transfers, chauffeur-driven executive transport, self-drive rentals and long-term vehicle arrangements. The fleet runs from sedans and SUVs through to premium luxury cars and coaches, matched to the traveller and the occasion — from consultants to MDs and CEOs — rather than defaulted to whatever vehicle is nearest.
Are premium and executive vehicles available?

Yes. Elyra offers access to executive sedans, premium vehicles and SUVs based on corporate requirements. Coaches are available for group movements, and every journey is driven by trained, vetted chauffeurs holding to safety, discretion and premium service standards.
Can ground transport be billed centrally?

Yes. Elyra supports centralised invoicing and cost-centre-based billing structures. Individual journeys roll up into one consolidated bill mapped to the cost centres you already use, across airport transfers, day-long executive use, event shuttling and long-term vehicle attachments for projects.
Is support available for urgent or last-minute requests?

Yes. Dedicated teams provide round-the-clock support for time-sensitive transportation needs. Journeys are coordinated in real time against safety protocols and service-level assurance, so a late change is absorbed into the day rather than handled as an exception.
Can bookings be managed through a single platform?

Yes. The Travgenie booking portal enables centralised booking, visibility and policy-aligned transport management. Ground transport sits in the same platform as your stays, so a trip is booked, tracked and reported as one thing rather than split across separate systems.

Short-term business stays, long-duration assignments and project-based hotel requirements across global destinations. The same process covers a single executive travelling for two nights and a whole project team placed in one city for months — one brief sets out the city, dates, duration and the policy being worked to.
Does Elyra offer negotiated corporate hotel rates?

Yes. Elyra provides access to negotiated rates aligned with corporate budgets and volume requirements, drawn from an extensive global network of leading hotel chains covering every major international and premium brand. Shortlisted properties are checked for availability before they reach you, so the costed options you receive are ones you can actually book.
Can hotel bookings be billed centrally?

Yes. Elyra supports flexible billing structures, including centralised invoicing and cost-centre mapping across short stays, extended assignments and long-term projects. Billing is routed to the right cost centre when the booking is confirmed, so the arrangement matches how your finance team already works.
Is support available for urgent or last-minute bookings?

Yes. Dedicated teams provide round-the-clock support for time-sensitive and emergency booking needs, reachable on email and app-based communication for real-time assistance and issue resolution. That coordination continues for the length of the stay, covering changes, extensions and escalations rather than stopping once the booking is confirmed.
Can bookings be managed through a single platform?

Yes. The Travgenie booking portal enables centralised control, visibility and policy-aligned hotel reservations. It is one of two booking models Elyra runs: corporates can self-serve through Travgenie for policy compliance and speed, or use the offline managed model with dedicated coordination teams — whichever suits the programme.

Meetings, incentives, conferences and events. Elyra plans and delivers all four across global destinations, covering leadership meetings, large-scale conferences, incentive programmes and brand events, with dedicated teams coordinating travel, venues, logistics and on-ground execution for each.

sections.title: Frequently asked questions
items: What is included in the Umrah package?

Breakfast, the Umrah visa, medical insurance and 5 litres of Zamzam water are included in all programmes. Premium hotels are selected near the Haram, private air-conditioned vehicles cover every transit, and Ziyarah tours are led by professional guides. Meal plans are chosen at booking — CP, MAP or all inclusive.
Are the Makkah and Madinah activities included?

No. Activities are optional add-ons, priced separately from the main Umrah programme. You can pick from either city, combine as many as you like, or take none at all — the core programme stands on its own. Opening hours vary by site, and the Umrah desk confirms them when your dates are set.

Packages are planned around your preferred dates rather than fixed departure windows — you decide how, when and with whom you travel. Durations run from 4 nights to 15 nights and beyond, so the trip fits corporate leave or a long weekend. Tell the Umrah desk your dates for a costed, bespoke itinerary, subject to availability.
Can I choose activities in more than one city?

Yes. You can pick activities in both Makkah and Madinah, and combine as many as you like. Makkah options include the Clock Tower Museum, the Hira Cultural District, the Ain Zubaida heritage waterway and the Kiswa Complex; Madinah has the Safiya Museum and Park, Ghars Well and the Quba area.

Four steps: select your programme, pick your city activities, confirm your dates, and book. You choose the itinerary that matches your interests, add any experiences and sightseeing tours, review availability against your preferred dates, then complete the booking and receive confirmation. Support runs 24/7 before, during and after the journey.
Are the activities suitable for all age groups?

Yes. Most of the listed activities — museums, markets and heritage sites — are suitable for all ages. The Clock Tower Museum and the Ain Zubaida waterway are both listed for all ages. The one to plan around is the Hira Cave Trail, which needs extra time on foot.
Who is this package best suited for?

Anyone planning Umrah who also wants to explore Makkah or Madinah alongside the pilgrimage. Packages are built around working professionals, families and senior citizens, and scale from an individual or a couple through to a corporate or community group of 50 and more.
